case_name: Biltu Bhattacharya vs The State Of West Bengal
author: Uday Umesh Lalit

paragraphs.text:
O R D E R
Delay in preferring Review Petition is condoned.
The conviction and sentence recorded against the petitioner for having

committed offences punishable under Sections 302 read with 120-B of the
IPC
and
Section 27(3)
of the Arms Act, 1959 by both the courts below, was

affirmed after considering the entire material on record.
This Review Petition is, therefore, dismissed.
……………………………….J.
 [Uday Umesh Lalit]
